title: Undo a buy in online rooms, and rename inside the room
problem: Informal feedback (REP-045): no undo after tapping a fruit before the buy is confirmed; the game name cannot be edited in the room. By code, an undo button already exists for one-device games (ActionBar.tsx shows it only when not online; turn.ts undoPoint) but it is hidden in online rooms, where a tap sends the buy at once (useGameController.ts). The mention of "the room" suggests the feedback game was online (inferred, not confirmed). Online undo needs a new legal action checked by the server.
scope: Step 1, no code: read server/room.ts and the online protocol, and propose how online undo should work (undo the last buy only, until the turn ends) and what rename in a room needs; the owner approves the design
Step 2: implement with tests for illegal, duplicate and stale actions, and reconnect (the online-authority rules in CLAUDE.md); keep the one-device undo unchanged
Undo must not reveal hidden information or let a player gain by undoing
